intro: Starweave the Elder is a Lunar Festival quest encountered in Darkshore. Adventurers seek out Elder Starweave in the settlement of Auberdine to pay their respects to the ancestral spirits of Kalimdor. In exchange for honoring ancient traditions, she offers celestial wisdom and her blessing.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The heavens, in their countless stars, hold answers to earthly mysteries, friend. Might, then, the wise, and the lucky, gaze up and find truth?

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
